desc: GitHub #39's Safe graphics ($TTYD_SAFE_GRAPHICS=1, port/safe_graphics.h) through the room the AYN Thor lost itself in: the boat's arrival at Rogueport's harbour (gor_00, story 2) and up the pier. From the start: no MSAA, the smaller graphics buffers, an older GPU's texture limits, per-draw values in a uniform binding; for the run the picture at 480 lines and every costly option off. It draws (draws counted each 60 frames), the guard never trips, and the flight record says safe graphics
